hypotheses.T0_independent_q_sketches_recover_task_s: Independent q probes recover rank-64 suffix-weighted operator subspaces with overlap at least 0.80 at every block.
hypotheses.T1_task_rank64_reconstructs_residual_obj: Unit-adjoint task rank 64 reaches at least 0.90 median held-out residual-objective response cosine at every block.
hypotheses.T2_task_rank64_beats_frobenius: Unit-adjoint task rank 64 exceeds Frobenius-operator rank 64 by at least 0.05 residual-objective response cosine at every block.
hypotheses.T3_task_rank64_beats_state_pca: Unit-adjoint task rank 64 exceeds state-PCA rank 64 by at least 0.05 residual-objective response cosine at every block.
hypotheses.T4_task_rank64_transfers_to_semantics: Unit-adjoint task rank 64 exceeds Frobenius rank 64 on held-out semantic responses in at least four of five blocks.
hypotheses.T5_task_rank256_is_high_fidelity: Unit-adjoint task rank 256 reaches at least 0.95 median response cosine for both residual and semantic objectives at every block.
hypotheses.T6_adjoint_magnitude_changes_the_basis: Raw- and unit-adjoint rank-64 subspaces have overlap below 0.90 in at least one block.
